versions.author: designer
versions.summary:
Two towns on one hillside: the Hive grows from gold you save each turn, the Carnival from gold you spend.
Save for a few turns, then spend the whole pile in one big turn; crossing units pay both towns.

versions.author: reviser
versions.summary:
Every card now prints its town (Hive, Carnival or Road), and Shell Masks, Ottavia's freeze and Clemenza are reworded so they read at a glance.
Small extras: Busker also pays on saving turns, Penniless Tenor tolerates one leftover coin, and Shell-Picker no longer makes empty Masks.

stop_reason: 2 of 3 reviewers said it's in a good spot
